nodes.text:
1/ What is HMPV?
Discovered in 2001, HMPV is a respiratory virus causing 5-10% of pediatric hospitalizations for respiratory infections. It primarily affects young children, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals.

nodes.author: sleepy__ash___
nodes.text:
2/
HMPV has a negative-sense RNA genome encoding 9 proteins.

Key players:
•Fusion protein (F): Mediates viral entry.
•N protein: Protects viral RNA.
•M2-2 protein: Suppresses immune responses, promoting re-infection.

HMPV binds heparan sulfate receptors for host cell entry.
